thesis: Power plant EPC contractor (gas fired and solar/battery, plus industrial and telecom segments) with no debt, 1,028.4M USD cash and investments, TTM revenue 1,188M (+57% 6M y/y) and net income 179M. After a 27% fall from 356.85 (2026-10-29) to 261.21 (2026-11-05) it trades at about 20x TTM earnings and 14x EV/EBIT, versus a P/E above 46 reported by a third party in August. Market may be extrapolating the AI and data center selloff and a backlog decline onto a cash rich contractor.
counterthesis: TTM operating cash flow 555M versus net income 179M is driven by customer advances: contract liabilities 627.0M (513.97M at 2026-01-31), so cash is largely customer money that unwinds as projects are built; FCF yield of about 15% is not owner earnings. Backlog fell to 2.5B from 2.9B in six months with no disclosed large new power award; the 2.5B is about 2.1 years of TTM revenue. Revenue and margin depend on a few large projects; Industrial and Teledata margins slipped on cost overruns; a UK project dispute (9.8M LC drawn, owner counterclaims, 27.2M pending variations). Three Power customers were about 23%, 16% and 11% of FY2026 revenue (10-K). Stock is cyclical and momentum driven (several 7 to 17% daily moves in 2026).
invalidation: Backlog continuing to fall without new power awards for two more quarters; a large project loss or margin charge; contract liabilities shrinking faster than new advances so OCF falls below net income; counterparty or credit trouble at a major customer.
